scope: AI technical inspection of 50 actual FFmpeg decoded samples across six matched pairs; not human beauty scoring or whole-video certification. All frame indices, hashes and source bindings are in actual-frame-inspection-manifest.json.

findings.observation: Baseline sample at7s has oversized text truncated at frame edges; current sample fits complete characters. Current4s sample is more legible against the same pale background.
Current4s sample wraps the phrase into a more continuous two-line reading; sampled primary phrases remain visible in both versions.

Current9s displays unfold horizontally, while baseline breaks it vertically. The exact7s boundary sample has no current primary word; this isolated sample requires phase interpretation, not a claim of missing the complete Let unit.
Current samples contain stronger doubled/heavy text effects than baseline. Words remain decipherable in these samples; aesthetic superiority and duration of the effect are not certified.
Selected words and recap phrases are visible in both versions at matched sample times. This sample set is not independent generic aesthetic improvement.
Sampled lyric phases remain readable in both versions. Both have a lyric-free blue ending sample at43.5s; artistic ending quality is UNVERIFIED.

judgment: No artistic100 claim. Specific legibility and wrapping improvements are visible; whole-film genre fitness and aesthetic superiority remain unverified. Full interval lyric safety is supplied separately by final artifact verification.
